servedExportBinding: Each completed web job exported its checked-out locked source and served that same job output through the owned proof wrapper. Export filenames, checkout OID, exact case inventory and successful wrapper outcomes are retained; successful HTML/trace/PNG outputs were not uploaded by the failure-only artifact policy. No SHA256 of unavailable served JS or fresh visible Edge pixels is invented.
qualificationBoundary: Actual complete R18 source/full267/protectedCI pass after import-CAS correction. Two matching independent closing reviews and protected conversation/main publication are separate final gates. No unavailable artifact JS SHA/pixels, native/device/physical accuracy/deployment/hook/human acceptance is inferred.
